definitions.full: H5498. sachab [ סָחַב ] verb drag ( Imperfect consecutive 1 singular ואסחב MI 18 , suffix ואסחבה Ib 12.13 ; Phoenician סחב Lzb 328 ; Arabic , Ethiopic ); — Qal Perfect 1plural וְסָחַ֫בְנוּ consecutive 2Sam 17:13 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יִסְחָבוּם Jer 49:20 ; 50:45 ; Infinitive absolute סָחוֺב 22:19 ; construct לִסְחֹב 15:3 ; — drag , a city עַדהַֿנַּחַל 2Sam 17:13 , corpses Jer 15:3 ; 22:19 , captives, under figure of sheep dragged off by wild beast 49:20 = 50:45 ( ᵐ5 passive, whence Schw Gie suppose a Niph`al יִסָּחֲבוּ ).
